title: Gauge-fixed reduced parent-action constraint and Schur-complement audit

block_reduction.rule: constraint blocks must be invertible and the reduced kinetic matrix must be positive definite

secured_results.ordering: constraints must be eliminated before canonical diagonalization
secured_results.ghost_warning: positive K_QQ does not imply positive K_eff
secured_results.tachyon_warning: mass constraint mixing can generate a negative Schur-complement eigenvalue
secured_results.ward_condition: a protected massless Theta mode requires a common null direction of the reduced mass matrix and dangerous vertices

presets.protected: invertible positive constraint blocks, exact Theta Ward null direction and vanishing dangerous vertex
presets.kinetic: constraint kinetic couplings make K_eff indefinite
presets.mass: constraint mass mixing generates a tachyonic reduced Theta direction
presets.generic: moderate block mixing with nonzero induced Wilson indicator

limitations: the matrices are benchmark inputs rather than second variations of the COS-02.2B parent action
the algebraic Schur audit is not a complete Dirac constraint classification
BRST ghosts, gauge-fixing determinants and boundary constraint algebras are not implemented
tensor, vector, brane-bending and higher KK sectors remain omitted
no evidence effect; K1-D and K1-E remain closed
